bounded_question: Can the current shared-identity packet set remain recognizable, hierarchical, accessible and semantically restrained under small scale, monochrome, forced colors, 200% text, no-image, reduced-motion/static fallback, narrow reflow and APP↔WEB translation without promoting provisional components into final authority?

inputs.mechanism: Ring + Edge Witness non-color selection treatment
Distributed Recognition Mesh canonical Phase C Character-presence architecture

reduction_law: Do not shrink every identity artifact uniformly. C0 and CPS-B carry the smallest-scale burden; O3 is an identity-moment carrier and may be omitted below its lawful compact range rather than distorted.
Human-readable product/Character labels remain valid redundant identity carriers where present; typography fixture choice is not final type authority.
MAT F1 may become visually quieter or disappear in forced-colors when it carries no task/identity semantics; it must never be required to understand state or identity.
STA F2 selection treatment must remain distinguishable from keyboard focus and from progress/navigation/status meaning.
MOT F1A/CS2 cannot be required for comprehension. Reduced motion must retain state/context through static presentation or CUT.
Optional expressive Character depiction is absent from the canonical durability carrier; no-image must be a first-class state, not an error simulation.
test_roles: SYMBOL_MICRO_16_20_24 — exact C0 geometry at smallest identity-bearing sizes in currentColor only
WORDMARK_IDENTITY_MOMENT — exact O3 geometry at bounded non-micro widths; below range use semantic name rather than forced shrink
CHARACTER_MICRO_CPS_B — CPS-B signatures remain recoverable without portrait, color or motion
COMPACT_IDENTITY_STACK — current shared identity carriers coexist without one provisional axis visually swallowing the others
NARROW_REFLOW_320 — integrated stack reflows without horizontal overflow or clipped identity
TEXT_200 — text enlargement preserves hierarchy and geometry remains identity-stable
MONOCHROME_CURRENTCOLOR — identity remains legible without palette
FORCED_COLORS — essential identity/state survives system-color substitution
NO_IMAGE — canonical identity/state remains complete with zero expressive images
STATIC_REDUCED_MOTION — motion mechanisms reduce to static/CUT without information loss
SELECTION_VS_FOCUS — STA F2 witness and keyboard focus remain visibly/programmatically distinct
APP_WEB_TRANSLATION — same identity facts/carriers survive restrained APP and more expressive WEB composition without copied layout

required_checks: exact C0/O3 source geometry hashes preserved in construction source
CPS-B signature identity preserved across APP/WEB
all micro carriers retain required structural cues
selection witness remains distinct from focus

promotion_floor: DUR-01 may pass only after the full mechanical/accessibility matrix is clean and Design Sol finds no material identity collapse, hierarchy inversion, state/focus ambiguity, motion dependency, forced-color dependency, provisional-to-final authority smuggling, or generic avatar/logo-dashboard drift.
excluded_variables: CLR F2/F1 selection or palette tokenization
final symbol/wordmark production master or trademark
final Character artwork/portrait family or renderer generation
Phase C exit by DUR-01 alone
sequence: construct one neutral deterministic carrier from the frozen inputs and reduction law
run mechanical/accessibility preflight and repair carrier defects before subjective evaluation
Design Sol evaluates only after clean preflight; no result-aware retuning
packetize durability result and update continuity
run recursive audit; any later integration conflict opens a bounded successor/refinement gate
